items.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
items.snippet: A rentable Android spyware kit called uCreator takes over Telegram and WeChat accounts by hiding its code inside working copies of the two apps, researcher Ovi found. It only reaches people who install one of these tampered copies, spread outside the official app stores, or who run WeChat inside the kit makers' own con
items.summary: Researcher Ovi found uCreator spyware hides in tampered Telegram and WeChat copies to take over accounts. It reaches people who install copies spread outside official channels.
items.why: Warn users to install messaging apps through official channels and check for tampered copies.

items.title: Gheist Uses Stolen GitHub Tokens to Steal Private Repository Secrets via Actions Logs
items.snippet: An automated campaign is using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that print a repository's secrets into its GitHub Actions logs, which the attackers then download before deleting the runs. The attacks have succeeded in private repositories and GitHub Enterprise environments, according to an analysis by cloud secu
items.summary: The report says attackers use stolen GitHub tokens to add workflows that expose repository secrets in Actions logs, then download the logs and delete the runs.

The file is called AGENTS.md, a plain text document developers place in a project
items.summary: Forever Security says files saved to Downloads without approval can trick AI coding agents into installing a malicious npm package or handing over a login token when opened in that folder.
items.why: Check Downloads for unapproved files before opening projects with AI coding agents.

Unmanned systems are platforms that operate without a person aboard. The title describes them as central to a Turkish military demonstration.
Military assistance is support provided to another country's military. The item says European defence ministers plan to discuss increasing such support to Ukraine.

analysis.headline: Capabilities, procurement and security claims in focus
paragraphs: The top stories span cyber operations, unmanned systems, procurement and political coordination. PHP2Shell vulnerabilities are reported exploited in the wild, while Kali adds hacking tools. In warfare, a Turkish demonstration highlights an unmanned aircraft, and procurement lessons focus on buying commercial technologies quickly.

Across these stories, capability and how it is developed or deployed are recurring themes. The reports suggest analysts should distinguish demonstrated systems and stated plans from confirmed operational effects. For defenders, the reported exploitation makes vulnerability tracking relevant; the Kali release also underscores the changing security-tool landscape.

The political stories add context: European ministers plan to discuss more military assistance to Ukraine, while a secretive meeting in Beijing may involve tighter party discipline. The coalition's account of strikes on missile facilities is a claim, not independently established here. Watch for further details on these discussions and reports.
takeaways: Track the reported PHP2Shell exploitation and assess relevant exposure.
Separate demonstrated unmanned systems from procurement plans and operational claims.
Follow the stated agendas and claims in the political and conflict stories.
